summary: The Blinding Vale offers a left-or-right route choice and mechanics centered on interrupts, blossom interception, roots, locked cones, and damage-buff orbs.
actions: Interrupt Light Bolt Volley, Light Bolt, Disorienting Screech, Warden's Wrath, and Lightspore Shot.
Break players out of Bloodthorn Roots and focus Lightgorged Lasher shields before their nearby healing becomes costly.
For the Lightblossom Trinity, step into the blossom to intercept the beam rather than standing in front of it.
For Lightwarden Ruia, spread the locked Pulverizing Strikes cones and stand still once targeted.
For Ziekket, soak Lightbloom's Essence for its damage benefit while preparing for the incoming damage, then aim Concentrated Lightbeam through dead adds.

provenance.description: Original compact strategy summary derived from targeted review of Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
